zh_cn.name: 现代军武
zh_cn.description: 战地式的冷色 HUD：平移的罗盘带、旋转扫描的雷达、开火扩散的准星、受击方向和依次滑入的击杀信息。

en_us.name: Modern Military
en_us.description: A cool-toned Battlefield-style HUD: a sliding compass strip, a sweeping radar, a crosshair that spreads when firing, hit direction and kill notices sliding in one by one.
